subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should this combined WebChat ordering/context report remain open until one end-to-end proof covers both symptoms, or should maintainers split it across the narrower assistant-final and user-turn durability trackers now?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations and there are separate open candidate paths, but automation cannot safely decide whether maintainers want this concrete combined report retained, split, or closed against narrower canonical items.

options.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open until landed code proves the visible order, durable history, and assembled context together for the direct WebChat case.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the assistant duplicate part to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85771 and the user-turn durability/context part to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86946, then close this issue with those links.

options.title: Close As Mitigated
options.body: Treat current main's partial UI and recorder mitigations as sufficient despite no direct combined proof, accepting the risk that one race remains hidden.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Until Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until landed code proves the visible order, durable history, and assembled context together for the direct WebChat case.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable user-turn/session boundary is the harder shared part of the combined report and has the strongest ownership signal in current history.
